title: NINJA GAIDEN 4
summary: The game asks Media Foundation whether anything decodes VP9 and quits if the answer is zero; on D3DMetal 4 its fences are repaired so it presents at all. Needs the staged Matroska demuxer too, except on CrossOver Preview 27, which ships it.

excerpts.note: When the engine finds no VP9 decoder, the gate the game asks Media Foundation is answered with the H.264 decoder's entry, so the game goes on and decodes in software.
On D3DMetal 4: a fence wait for a value no one has signalled yet is bridged through the CPU instead of being handed to the GPU.
